items.html: The second interpretation is that the ten Sefirot of Katnut, which are entirely Elokim, are divided into two aspects, which are pregnancy and nursing. For the three lower ones of Elokim are pregnancy, and the six upper ones together are called nursing. And afterward, all the ten Sefirot of Gadlut, which are Havayot, are called the second pregnancy. And all these three aspects are called externality. And after all these three above-mentioned aspects, which are the aspect of Achor be-Achor (back to back), which are called externality, there are three corresponding aspects, which are the aspect of Panim be-Panim (face to face), and they are called internality. And indeed, all these two aspects — the externality called Achor be-Achor, and the internality called Panim be-Panim — all of them are from the NHY of Tevuna and Yeshsut. And there are two other aspects corresponding to them, namely the back and the face of the supernal Aba and Ima, and they are called externality and internality.
